First release of Itemerness and its standalone editor.

- Bukkit plugin with exact-version adapters for Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2.
- Item, theme, layout, data, translation and resource authoring, with direct plugin connections and server-compiled previews.
- Portable editor for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows x64.

Install `Itemerness.jar` in the server's `plugins` directory. Minecraft 26.x requires Java 25; 1.21.11 requires Java 21 or newer. Enable and secure the editor API before connecting. Saving an editor draft does not publish it to the runtime catalog.

macOS builds are ad-hoc signed, not notarized; Windows builds are unsigned. Gatekeeper or SmartScreen may warn. Windows requires the system WebView2 Runtime. Resource packs and Mojang client assets are not bundled.

`SHA256SUMS` covers all four downloads.
